behavior: Authenticate each distinct support-introducing published Work against its retained certificate, owner, source, application version, request hash and full ticket.
Expand committed receipt names once per Work and match exact support, assignment and actual alias UUIDs. Later support can legitimately belong to an older assignment.
Retain every active support count and source/extraction/person freshness owner even when evidence witnesses are bounded or a stored proof is invalid.
Use original structural proof checks when both certificate fields are genuinely absent. Malformed or contradictory certificates invalidate facts instead of falling back.
Check migration-57 table availability before parsing SQL that names those tables, preserving actual schema-53 readers.

queryMeasurement.note: Comparable synthetic local snapshots during application activity; not isolated application throughput, catalog cost or matching accuracy.

compatibility: No schema, people facts version, current alias selection, owner collection or public write contract changes.
review: Independent correctness and readability reviews found no issues. Public fault tests cover certificate metadata and actual Work hash, ticket, owner and state; genuine restoration recovers valid facts.
remaining: Complete large repeat checkpoint capacity and distinct-person orchestration work.
Measure post-visibility-migration and catalog-scale query cost, then evaluate automatic matching independently.
